name: Nagi — Meditation, Sleep & Breathing
summary:
Step away from the noise. Nagi places you inside nine handcrafted immersive environments — each one a quiet invitation to slow down, breathe, and let the day dissolve.

**Nine worlds, one breath at a time**

Drift beneath a canopy of sakura petals on a sunlit hill. Sit on the engawa of a Japanese garden as lanterns glow at dusk. Watch the aurora trace slow arcs over a still mountain lake.
